method: Read issue bodies and all comments; inspect current creator/validator source, local standards, and PDF object structures. No conversion or full validation run performed. No GitHub comment or code change made.
rule_number_note: Issue numbers refer to an older rule numbering. Match by rule code and subject, not current numeric ID.

findings.evidence: Historical compare/thinkbox.pdf: 2 malformed child arrays and 3 missing/wrong parents; examples/eml/eml_sample_1s.pdf: zero of each.
Historical sample: two 32-byte CheckSum values; current example: two 16-byte values. PdfMailWriter.setEmbeddedChecksum enforces 16 bytes.
Historical sample has zero page-stream MCID sequences; current example has 31. This count is not a full accessibility certification.

Project reversed forced stripping on 2026-10-27. veraPDF issue 1647 comment 6457552448 says a forthcoming ISO 19005-4 revision changes shall to should; this is not proof that the revision has been published.
Existing upstream review explicitly retains the EA-PDF requirement pending authoritative change.
DocumentPartChecks defaults missing End to Start; Python also supports the single-page default.
Pinned EA-PDF section 9.3 printed p65 explicitly requires file attachment annotations in each email body content set. An AttachmentList rendering does not replace that requirement.

LogicalStructureChecks.java and validate_eapdf.py require literal S=Document for the root. Neither resolves a custom root role to Document. Java checks custom RoleMapNS entry presence without resolving its target here. Full upstream ISO checks are separate.

ISO 32000-2 section 14.8.6.2 uses root RoleMap when no explicit NS is present, and namespace RoleMapNS for explicit NS. EA-PDF section 9.7 separately requires compatibility mappings. Do not remove all RoleMap checks.
Pinned EA-PDF section 9.8/Table 14 printed pp83-84 explicitly lists pdfmail alongside pdfmailid and pdfmailmeta.

dc:creator accepts creator names rather than a software-only grammar. CreateDate presence/type are checked; both validators treat unavailable provenance as unavailable rather than infer it from equality to Sent. Pinned EA-PDF 9.8 explicitly names EA-PDF file creation date.
